name: Yao Yün-wen
bio: Yao Yün-wen (姚雲文; Yao Yunwen; 13th century) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 紫萸香慢 (Zi yu xiang man)
poems.author: Yao Yün-wen
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
近重阳、偏多风雨，绝怜此日暄明。
问秋香浓未，待携客、出西城。
正自羁怀多感，怕荒台高处，更不胜情。
向尊前、又忆洒酒插花人。
只座上、已无老兵。
凄情。
浅醉还醒。
愁不肯、与诗平。
记长楸走马，雕弓笮柳，前事休评。
紫萸一枝传赐，梦谁到、汉家陵。
尽乌纱、便随风去，要天知道，华发如此星星。
歌罢涕零。
